summary: TitleChain Foundation's submitted comment asks the Commission to encourage voluntary, implementation-neutral open standards for interoperable transfer-agent infrastructure while each regulated entity keeps control of its legally authoritative records. It addresses the difference between a wallet and legally accountable authority; credential-bound human and entity authority; machine-readable restrictive legends and transfer conditions; a Ricardian separation of human-readable terms, machine-readable meaning and executable instructions; pre-activation controls for automated agents; separation of origination authority from later transfer and correction authority; preservation of the underlying right across wrappers and rails; and examinable, fail-closed, portable evidence. The Foundation does not ask that any registry be required or supersede a transfer agent's official records. This is the Foundation's submitted position, not an SEC finding or adopted standard.
